brief.recommendation: Checkout is failing at 45% over the last 15s (27/60 timeouts) with $4,155/min at risk against a 95% SLO, and BIZ-4 shows 0% success over 30s with $18,400/min at risk. The business tolerates at most 60s of degraded checkout. The root blocker pid 114304 (adhoc_reporting, idle in transaction, txn open 4.0s) holds locks blocking checkout sessions. audit.report: An unknown workload, adhoc_reporting (pid 114304), held a lock while idle in transaction for 4.0 seconds, blocking 12 sessions and degrading checkout. Checkout success fell to 55% over 15 seconds (27 timeouts) and then to 0% over 30 seconds (120/120 failed), putting $4,155/min and then $18,400/min at risk against a 95% SLO. The Database Guardian proposed terminating the blocking session after confirming no protected settlements were in flight and no change-calendar window was active. The Continuity Guardian escalated because adhoc_reporting is not in the workload registry, so its owner, replayability, and interrupt policy are unknown. No action was executed within the 189.6-second negotiation, and the incident ended escalated to on-call without restoring checkout.
audit.root_cause: An untracked adhoc_reporting session held a blocking lock while idle in transaction, and the lack of a registry entry prevented a priced termination decision before the business tolerance window expired.
lessons: Register adhoc_reporting in the workload registry with owner, replayability, replay cost, and interrupt policy so a future blocker can be priced and terminated without escalation.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian used all available evidence and did not waste a round; the Continuity Guardian correctly invoked invariant I4 to block termination of an unregistered workload. No guardian missed evidence, but the invariant forced escalation and no recovery action was executed.
follow_ups: Identify the owner of adhoc_reporting and add it to the workload registry with interrupt and replay policy.
Review whether any checkout transactions were left in an inconsistent state during the 0% success period and reconcile revenue impact.
Define a pre-approved auto-termination path for unknown idle-in-transaction blockers when business degradation exceeds the tolerance threshold.
